prs.title: fix(server): preserve plain JSON Schema in deprecated server.tool() overload
prs.author: stakeswky
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed to `server.tool()` are not handled correctly in `src/server/mcp.ts` — the registration pipeline either misroutes them (treating them as `ToolAnnotations`) or fails to preserve them when converting to the wire format. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed to `server.tool()` are not handled correctly in `src/server/mcp.ts` — the registration pipeline either misroutes them (treating them as `ToolAnnotations`) or fails to preserve them when converting to the wire format. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1617 handles the root cause by detecting plain JSON Schema at the `inputSchema` serialization boundary (`isLikelyJsonSchema` guard before `normalizeObjectSchema`) and preserving it as-is, which maintains backward compatibility for the deprecated overload. It also widens the `inputSchema` type to `ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema`, making the fix structurally correct. PR #1596 instead throws an error when a nested-object value is found in the annotations position — a heuristic that could produce false positives and breaks existing callers rather than supporting them. The two diffs would conflict on merge since both modify the same region of `mcp.ts`.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1617 handles the root cause by detecting plain JSON Schema at the `inputSchema` serialization boundary (`isLikelyJsonSchema` guard before `normalizeObjectSchema`) and preserving it as-is, which maintains backward compatibility for the deprecated overload. It also widens the `inputSchema` type to `ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema`, making the fix structurally correct. PR #1596 instead throws an error when a nested-object value is found in the annotations position — a heuristic that could produce false positives and breaks existing callers rather than supporting them. The two diffs would conflict on merge since both modify the same region of `mcp.ts`.
